name: Ykslammi Beach
description: The village beach on Ykslammi: a smoke sauna, a pier, a lean-to with a fire ring. In winter there's a hole in the ice for the brave.
greeting: Someone is already in the lake, howling.
A disc golf frisbee lands in the reeds.
The fire is going at the laavu.

hello: The stove's been heating since morning.
Leave your worries in the changing room.
sauna: Back again? You'll turn into a ham.
sausage: Sausage after sauna. The only way.
broke: The sauna fee goes in the tin. You're short.
kiosk: The kiosk's yours. Coffee for me, on credit.
Good. Now the beach has a proper boss.
work: The worms are in the fridge. Not next to the ice cream, I hope.
A quiet day. More time for the sauna.

lines: You throw a ladle of water on the stones. Sssssh! The old men nod in respect.
Someone has written KIUAS on the bucket in marker pen, in case anybody thought it was a hat.
You throw another ladle. And another. Kalevi looks proud. Your ears are melting.

then.message: Second sauna this week. Your skin is still pink from the last one. Kalevi checks you're not a lobster.

else.message: Löyly hisses on the stones. All worries melt away.

then.message: Another swim. A pike bites your toe. You are fine. The pike is smug.

else.message: Another swim. Your teeth chatter for an hour afterwards.

actions.label: Grill a sausage at the laavu

then.message: Nothing beats a sausage after sauna.
One sausage is tradition. Two is just lunch. It is a fine lunch, though.

else.message: A sausage without a sauna first. It's fine. Kalevi looks disappointed in you.
